[web - flash] Cardian - CCG and one dimensional RTS

This is another good and interesting game marred by a significant flaw. It's a CCG in which you win matches and earn cards by playing in a one-dimensional RTS (I don't know how else to describe this mechanic, but you'll recognize it immediately when you see it). There's a good number of cards and strategies, and all of the basic mechanics of the game are really refreshing and fun.

The big problem is that the deck building UI is huge pain in the ass, especially once you've accumulated a decent number of cards. It's painful to sort through them all. I respect that a flash dev has a limited amount of space to work in, but this needed to be done better. Unfortunately, the game didn't do very well and the dev didn't take it any further, and then I think he retired from flash development all together. It's really too bad, there are very few decent CCGs which aren't just storefronts nowadays and I had a ton of fun with this one.
